diagnosis.overview: The agent cannot reliably extract exact numeric values from source financial documents, causing hallucinations (e.g., 15.82% vs. 15.825% withholding rate, $1,008.19 interest vs. $1,116) and leading to incomplete or absent deliverables (missing schedules, no Excel workbook) due to retrieval failures and tool‑execution loops.
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent cannot reliably extract exact numeric values from source financial documents, causing hallucinations (e.g., 15.82% vs. 15.825% withholding rate, $1,008.19 interest vs. $1,116) and leading to incomplete or absent deliverables (missing schedules, no Excel workbook) due to retrieval failures and tool‑execution loops.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: Add a specialised financial‑document extraction tool (e.g., a PDF/Excel cell‑exact parser) and wire it into the agent's tool suite; complement with a system prompt rule that numeric values from source files must be extracted using this tool, never approximated from memory, and that all requested forms/schedules must be generated in full using precise extracted data.
